verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows versioned API endpoints: the documented endpoint is the unversioned https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google. Nothing shows a documented API deprecation policy either. The only deprecation notice concerns an older Python client package being replaced by serpapi-python, and there is an ad-hoc note about a Google Finance parameter change. Both are adjacent to this story and do not count as an API versioning or deprecation policy.
